items.title: "This isn't a sign to retreat": Rockstar's historic union vote has failed, with 75% voting against, but the organisers are going to "keep fighting"
items.en_title: "This isn't a sign to retreat": Rockstar's historic union vote has failed, with 75% voting against, but the organisers are going to "keep fighting"
items.en_oneliner: Rockstar’s historic vote on formal union recognition failed with 75% voting against, as around 1,600 studio members cast ballots, but organisers say they will keep fighting.

items.title: An apology from RPS
items.en_oneliner: The RPS editor apologises again for a previous apology that unfairly targeted one of its own writers, saying he will apologise to that writer directly.

items.title: Why Game Top-Up Fails at Checkout: ID Validation, Invoice States, and Delayed Callbacks
items.en_title: Why Game Top-Up Fails at Checkout: ID Validation, Invoice States, and Delayed Callbacks
items.en_oneliner: Game top-up checkouts often fail on small mismatches in player IDs, server or zone identifiers, or region eligibility; the author offers practical flow patterns to keep payment and fulfilment in sync and cut support tickets.

items.title: GTA 6's Physical Launch Has Been An Astronomical Success, Despite No Discs
items.en_title: GTA 6's Physical Launch Has Been An Astronomical Success, Despite No Discs
items.en_oneliner: Even without any discs, GTA 6 posted the UK’s biggest physical game launch since 2019, generating £32 million in three days.

items.title: Aspects of GTA 6 are inspired by Red Dead Redemption 2's honor system because its player agency 'was a hard thing to ignore and walk away from'
items.en_title: Aspects of GTA 6 are inspired by Red Dead Redemption 2's honor system because its player agency 'was a hard thing to ignore and walk away from'
items.en_oneliner: Parts of GTA 6 draw on Red Dead Redemption 2’s honor system, whose player agency the team found hard to ignore.

items.title: Where to find GTA 6's UFO and alien
items.en_title: Where to find GTA 6's UFO and alien
items.en_oneliner: A guide to where players can find the UFO and alien in GTA 6.

items.title: We read 2,037 reviews of arrow puzzle games before building ours. Here's what they said
items.en_title: We read 2,037 reviews of arrow puzzle games before building ours. Here's what they said
items.en_oneliner: Before writing any code for Arrow Drift, the author read 2,037 player reviews of the ten biggest arrow puzzle games and turned the complaints — ad overload, mis-taps costing lives, boards too small — into the game’s design decisions.

items.title: Persistent vs session-based strategy games: what's the difference?
items.en_title: Persistent vs session-based strategy games: what's the difference?
items.en_oneliner: Under the same strategy label, some games offer a single match while others give players a kingdom that keeps existing between sessions; the author uses his own Crownfall: Kingdoms to unpack what each shape asks of players.

items.title: Rockstar workers vote overwhelmingly against union recognition
items.en_title: Rockstar workers vote overwhelmingly against union recognition
items.en_oneliner: Only 25% of Rockstar workers voted in favor of union recognition, and while the IWGB says efforts will continue, there is a long way to go.

items.title: How I Use Python's Z3 SAT Solver to Prove Printable Escape Room Puzzles Have Zero Contradictions (+ 4 Free Browser Tools)
items.en_title: How I Use Python's Z3 SAT Solver to Prove Printable Escape Room Puzzles Have Zero Contradictions (+ 4 Free Browser Tools)
items.en_oneliner: The author uses Python’s Z3 SAT solver to verify that printable escape-room clue chains contain no contradictions, plus four free browser tools, fixing hand-written clues’ double solutions and one-player-takes-all problem.

items.title: How to steal the Bravado Banshee in GTA 6
items.en_title: How to steal the Bravado Banshee in GTA 6
items.en_oneliner: Need a striped sports car for Randy? This guide shows where to find the Bravado Banshee and how to grab it.

items.title: DOGWALK for visionOS: Blender Studio releases the Apple Vision Pro source code
items.en_title: DOGWALK for visionOS: Blender Studio releases the Apple Vision Pro source code
items.en_oneliner: Blender Studio has released the source code of DOGWALK for visionOS, the Apple Vision Pro version of its Godot game shown at WWDC26, free for everyone to download.

items.title: Talking Point: Ocarina Of Time Revolutionised The 3D Swordfight, But How Does The Remake Hold Up In A Vintage Year For Clashing Blades?
items.en_title: Talking Point: Ocarina Of Time Revolutionised The 3D Swordfight, But How Does The Remake Hold Up In A Vintage Year For Clashing Blades?
items.en_oneliner: Looking back at how Ocarina of Time defined 3D sword combat, then measuring its remake against a standout year for blade-wielding games.

items.en_title: Free Play Days – Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus and Little Rocket Lab
